name: Shivathmika
bio:
Shivathmika Rajashekar (born April 22, 2000) is an Indian actress who works predominantly in Telugu and Tamil cinema. She made her feature film acting debut in the period romantic drama *Dorasaani* (2019), winning the SIIMA Award for Best Female Debut – Telugu.

In 2021, Rajashekar entered Tamil cinema with *Anandham Vilayadum Veedu*. Her subsequent releases included the Tamil drama *Nitham Oru Vaanam* (2022), the Telugu anthology *Panchathantram* (2022), and the family drama *Ranga Maarthaanda* (2023). She later appeared in the Tamil feature *Bomb* (2025) and *Aaromaley* (2025).
